abstract: We describe a case of primary mesenteric embryonal carcinoma. The patient was a 73-year-old man who presented with a huge mass palpable at the right upper side of the abdomen. Laboratory evaluations showed very high alpha-fetoprotein and PIVKA-II levels, and an abdominal computed tomographic scan demonstrated a mass contiguous with the liver. These findings suggested hepatic cell carcinoma extending beyond the liver. However, angiography showed the mass to be supplied mainly by the middle colic artery and greater omentum artery, suggesting a mesenteric tumor. Gastroscopy demonstrated a IIc lesion in the anterior wall of the antrum. This lesion was histologically diagnosed to be moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma. The large tumor adjacent to the liver was diagnosed to be a primary mesenteric tumor or a metastatic mesenteric tumor from arising gastric cancer. At laparotomy, a huge tumor was found in the gastrocolic ligament. The tumor adhered to the distal part of stomach, the transverse colon, and the gallbladder. En-bloc resection of the tumor was performed, including the distal part of stomach, Part of the transverse colon, and the gall-bladder. The tumor mass measured 26.0 x 21.0 x 9.0 cm, weighted 2750 g, and showed central necrosis and hemorrhage. The histopathological diagnosis was a primary embryonal carcinoma originating in the mesentery. Primary mesenteric embryonal carcinoma is extremely rare. To our knowledge, no other cases have been reported. We describe this case and briefly discuss the related literature.
abstract_ja: 73歳の男性が、上腹部に触知する巨大な腫瘤を主訴に受診した。検査ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とPIVKA-IIが著明に高値であった。コンピュータ断層撮影で肝に接する腫瘤が認められ、肝細胞癌が肝外へ進展したものと示唆された。血管造影では主に中結腸動脈と大網動脈から栄養されており、腸間膜腫瘍が示唆された。胃内視鏡検査では、胃前庭部前壁にIIc型病変を認めた。この病変は中等度分化型腺癌と診断された。肝に接する大きな腫瘍は、原発性腸間膜腫瘍か、胃癌からの転移性腸間膜腫瘍と診断された。開腹術では胃結腸間膜に巨大な腫瘍を認めた。腫瘍は胃の遠位部、横行結腸、胆嚢に癒着していた。胃遠位部、横行結腸の一部、胆嚢を含めて腫瘍を一括切除した。腫瘍は26.0×21.0×9.0cm、重量2750gで、中心壊死と出血を伴っていた。組織学的診断は、腸間膜に生じた原発性胎児性癌であった。原発性腸間膜胎児性癌は極めて稀であり、我々の知る限り他の症例報告はない。本症例を報告し、関連文献について簡単に考察する。
